szoveg_eredeti:
Wall Street Journal :

 Sources: Jensen Huang had planned to pull back Nvidia's aggressive financing and told neoclouds to get upfront customer payments; Colette Kress may go further   —  Interim CEO Colette Kress is expected to rein in deals after a stretch in which Nvidia aggressively financed computing deals and startup investments
